disha_shoola.mitigation: If west travel is essential on Sunday/Friday, consume jaggery or curd before embarking.

tarabala.description: Janma Tara (Birth Star) - Indicates physical strain or identity re-evaluation. Generally avoid for critical material ventures.

chandrabala.description: Janma Chandra (1st house): Mind focused on self; favorable/acceptable.

positive_factors: Safely outside Rahu Kalam (Rahu Kalam occurs 10:49 - 11:59).
Auspicious Lunar Day for Travel: Tithi 11 (Krishna Dashami) promotes fruitful completion of journey.
Clear directional path: Travel towards North is free of Disha Shoola on Friday.
Personal Chandrabala Favorable: Transit Moon is in house 1 (Libra) from your natal Moon (Libra) - Janma Chandra (1st house): Mind focused on self; favorable/acceptable.
negative_factors: Active Vishti (Bhadra) Karana. Carries heavy obstruction; avoid for contracts, marriage, or journeys.

Personal Tarabala Affliction: Transit Nakshatra (Swati) is your Janma (Tara #1) - Janma Tara (Birth Star) - Indicates physical strain or identity re-evaluation. Generally avoid for critical material ventures.
recommendation: Inauspicious timing for travel. Notable afflictions (such as Rahu Kalam, Rikta Tithi, Tarabala/Chandrabala friction, or conflicting asterisms) suggest rescheduling if possible.
